title: Beef Feijoada
description: Hearty Portuguese stew made with beef, beans, and vegetables. Feijoada is a popular dish originating from Brazil, but with a Portuguese twist.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.amount: 1 pound (450g) beef brisket or beef shank

instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Sear the beef cubes until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Sauté the onion and garlic until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth, browned beef, and chopped kale to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 1-2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with rice, farofa, or crusty bread.
